request.text: 不要预览文件夹内的其他文件 ,使用three.js,制作一个单html程序,要求是极其精细的现代主战坦克模型,可以预览,操控,真实,帅气,炫技写真.

confirmedFailures: Advisor total deadline at 300000ms cut off a concrete appearance review; the executor treated partial reasoning as completed review and applied six parameter edits.
The advisor result had no complete report and no image material, so parameter edits were conditional hypotheses rather than verified visual conclusions.
The final artifact initially failed real browser initialization because skyDir was referenced but never initialized; this was fixed locally by adding ENV.skyDir.

A fresh Edge run after that fix reached ready with one canvas and no Runtime exceptions, but captureScreenshot timed out and emitted GPU ReadPixels stall warnings; no reliable pixel-quality acceptance is established.
Final regenerated stub harness intentionally skipped initEnv, the very path modified after the incomplete advisor call. It could not verify the new startup code.
fixesApplied: Advisor default total deadline is now null; explicit DSH_PO06_ADVISOR_TIMEOUT_MS is accepted without min/max clamping.
Read-only advisor loop accepts budgetMs:null while retaining max read rounds and external cancellation.
UI omits the false deadline progress bar when no timeout is configured.
Latest HTML has ENV.skyDir initialized; fresh Edge reached the ready state after this fix.

verification.limits: No final visual or whole-task acceptance; definitive patched browser evidence is in LATEST-SESSION-DISASTER-FIX.json.

conclusion: This is a real execution-chain failure, not merely prompt variance. Removing the plugin deadline prevents this specific premature advisor cut, but it does not validate the six edits or the final visual quality.

cdnRecovery.actualRecovery: Executor switched to bash/curl and examined CDN/API source paths. The initial web_fetch errors add overhead; they alone do not prove all API claims unverified.
